records.text: Candace Owens said that, unless her team was mistaken, the earliest public mention it found of the Utah Valley University courtyard location was September 2; she said an August 27 event graphic had no location details and invited correction if that was inaccurate.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: So unless I am mistaken and I am not perfect, but I do feel like we worked really hard to see when this location was first revealed. The first time that we found that the courtyard was mentioned because Charlie (Charlie Kirk) speaking at events, your assumption would be there inside, right? You have no idea where it is. So it's not like you can see whether you have a shot. to the courtyard unless you know Charlie (Charlie Kirk) speaking in the courtyard. The earliest that we found that was on September 2nd, the local media mentioned on KMYU that Charlie (Charlie Kirk) was speaking at UVU in the courtyard, okay? That's the first time that we found this. If I am wrong, please tag me because what he's referring to on August 27th that happened, which we have on our timeline as well, and this is why I love a timeline, is that TPUSA, UVU, and the local BYU chapter shared a graphic announcing that Charlie (Charlie Kirk) was coming to UVU, but there were absolutely no location details mentioned. So that actually does shred the idea that he could have practically gone and scaled rooftops before September 2nd. That's the first public mention is September 2nd. So they announced the event on August 27th, as he says, no location details. And then on September 2nd, there are location details provided by local media for the first time. Prove me wrong. Okay. Prove me wrong if that is, if I'm inaccurate, because I do think that we were thorough on that.

verification.notes: Transcript context at 3068.108 carefully frames September 2 as the earliest mention Owens's team found and invites correction. Current reporting confirms an August 27 tour announcement and that the selected venue was the Sorensen Student Center courtyard, but it does not provide a complete archive of every public post, campus notice, or broadcast before September 2. The universal earliest-public-mention claim therefore cannot be conclusively established.
